items.text: Looking back, I wish we ___ the contract terms more carefully before signing.

ok.de: Bedauern über etwas Vergangenes: wish + had + Partizip (I wish we had checked). Looking back und before signing zeigen die Vergangenheit.
ok.en: Regret about the past: wish + had + participle (I wish we had checked). Looking back and before signing point to the past.

wrong.de: wish + Past Simple meint die Gegenwart; Bedauern über Vergangenes braucht had checked.
wrong.en: wish + past simple is about the present; regret about the past needs had checked.

wrong.de: Deutsch „ich wünschte, wir würden“; für Vergangenes steht wish + had + Partizip.
wrong.en: German “ich wünschte, wir würden”; for the past English uses wish + had + participle.

wrong.de: Nach wish steht kein Present Perfect; Vergangenes braucht had checked.
wrong.en: No present perfect after wish; the past needs had checked.

items.text: We are looking for a partner ___ software can handle documents in more than twenty languages.

ok.de: Besitz im Relativsatz: whose + Nomen (a partner whose software = ein Partner, dessen Software).
ok.en: Possession in a relative clause: whose + noun (a partner whose software).

wrong.de: which braucht direkt ein Verb (which can …); hier fehlt das „dessen“.
wrong.en: which needs a verb right after it (which can …); the sentence needs “whose”.

wrong.de: who's heißt who is; „who is software“ ergibt keinen Sinn.
wrong.en: who's means who is; “who is software” makes no sense.

wrong.de: that kann kein „dessen“ ausdrücken; vor einem Nomen steht whose.
wrong.en: that cannot mean “whose”; whose goes before a noun.

items.text: Several customers have complained about the ___ of the new login process.

ok.de: Nach „the“ und vor „of“ steht ein Nomen: complex + -ity = die Komplexität. Auch der Plural complexities passt.
ok.en: A noun goes after “the” and before “of”: complex + -ity = complexity. The plural complexities also fits.

wrong.de: „complex“ ist ein Adjektiv; nach „the“ und vor „of“ braucht der Satz ein Nomen.
wrong.en: “complex” is an adjective; after “the” and before “of” the sentence needs a noun.

wrong.de: „complexly“ ist ein Adverb; hier braucht der Satz ein Nomen.
wrong.en: “complexly” is an adverb; the sentence needs a noun here.

items.lead: People say that the new CEO is planning a major restructuring.

ok.de: Teil 1: is said, die Person wird Subjekt (neutral berichten). Teil 2: to be planning, weil das Planen gerade läuft.
ok.en: Part 1: is said, the person becomes the subject (neutral reporting). Part 2: to be planning, because the planning is going on now.

wrong.de: Das Planen läuft gerade (is planning): to be planning, nicht to plan.
wrong.en: The planning is going on now (is planning): to be planning, not to plan.

wrong.de: Es fehlt is: The new CEO is said to be planning.
wrong.en: is is missing: The new CEO is said to be planning.
